pensamiento:
I'm checking EV-02 against the quality criteria, starting with the user story text, which has a clear role and action. The first check, QUS-001, passes because the role and action are both present. For QUS-002 I'm looking at whether it has a single objective, which it does, since it's one validation feature even though the criteria list several checks, so it probably passes too.

I'm working through the remaining quality checks on EV-02. QUS-003 through QUS-005 look fine: the acceptance criteria are separate, the benefit is a real justification, and the UI details don't impose a technology. QUS-006 is where I'm slowing down, since phrases like "columns mapped as amounts" and "a short explanation" for errors could be read more than one way.

I'm weighing whether "a short explanation" for the errors is a real defect. "Short" has no measure, so a tester couldn't verify it, which makes it a candidate for a major-severity QUS-006 finding that would send the story back.

I'm now weighing whether the missing rule about how amount columns get mapped, and what counts as a numeric value, is a real gap in DOR-002, since the file size limit is stated but the mapping step is not.

I'm settling on QUS-006 as the one defect here, since "a short explanation" has no measure and the amount-column mapping source isn't defined. For INV-001 the story doesn't reference another story, and the Publish button looks like existing functionality, so I'm treating dependencies as not an issue.

I'm checking the remaining invest criteria on EV-02. The Publish button looks like existing functionality rather than an external dependency, so DOR-001 holds. INV-002 passes because the benefit is explicit for the user. For INV-003 I'm noting what seems missing: the delimiter and encoding, where the amount-column mapping comes from, and what "short explanation" means.

I'm now judging INV-004, the size check, against the CSV validator in view.

I'm checking the remaining invest criteria, and INV-004 looks fine as a small story. For INV-005 I'm looking at whether the criteria are verifiable: most are observable, but "a short explanation" has no measure a tester could check, so I'm leaning toward marking it as not meeting the criterion.

I'm going through the remaining quality checks on EV-02: QUS-007 through QUS-009 look fine, since no other story conflicts with it and the format matches the backlog's "As a ... I want ... so that ..." pattern. I'll flag QUS-006 for the vague "short explanation" and the undefined amount-column mapping, and I'm also considering INV-005 for the same unverifiable criterion.

I've settled on two defects for EV-02: QUS-006 for the vague "short explanation" and the undefined amount-column mapping, and INV-005 because that same criterion can't be verified. That points to returning the story. Next I'll check the estimation scale and reference stories before registering the findings.

Aclara también cómo se marca una columna como 'mapped as amounts' (quién lo define y de dónde sale) y qué se considera valor numérico.

El criterio de la explicación de error no se puede comprobar sin interpretación. Reemplázalo por una regla observable, por ejemplo: 'Cada error muestra número de fila, nombre de columna y el texto X'. Además, completa el título, que está vacío.

revision.historia_refinada: Como Data Publishing User, quiero saber si mi archivo CSV es válido, para corregir posibles problemas de datos antes de publicarlo en Open Spending.
criterios_aceptacion: Si el archivo no tiene fila de cabecera, el validador muestra un error y el botón Publicar permanece deshabilitado.
Si alguna fila tiene distinto número de columnas que las demás, el validador reporta cada error con número de fila y nombre de columna.
Si una columna mapeada como monto contiene valores no numéricos, el validador reporta cada error con número de fila y nombre de columna.
Si el archivo es válido, el validador muestra 'File is valid' y habilita el botón Publicar.
Si el archivo es inválido, el botón Publicar permanece deshabilitado.
Un archivo de hasta 50 MB termina su validación en menos de 30 segundos.
